newsitem.title: USA: DataMark names Barry Kelley CFO.
newsitem.headline: DataMark names Barry Kelley CFO.

text.p: DataMark Holding Inc, a national direct marketing and online company, said Wednesday it hired Barry Kelly as its chief financial officer and executive vice president.
Kelly replaces Jim Egide, who will continue to be on its board, the company said.

Before his appointment, Kelly was managing director of Capstone Partners, an investment banking boutique with offices in Salt Lake City. He also was previously connected with Nomura Securities International and Morgan Stanley & Co, where he held executive positions.

DataMark, through its DataMark Systems unit, provides direct mail advertising campaigns for more than 200 clients in the U.S. It also operates a unit called SISNA, which is in the telecommunications business in 16 states.
The company said it is scheduled to launch WorldNow Online Network this month to provide customized information and advertising services online.
